dagger.name: Dagger
dagger.desc: Quick and quiet. Everyone starts with one, and it can never be dropped.

spear.name: Spear
spear.desc: Reach and steady damage. Good for keeping rivals at arm's length.

arrows.name: Arrows
arrows.desc: Ammunition for the bow and crossbow.

axe.name: Axe
axe.desc: The hardest melee hit, at the cost of stamina.

bandage.name: Bandage
bandage.desc: Stops bleeding and restores a little health.

healthKit.name: Health kit
healthKit.desc: Restores a large amount of health and stops bleeding.

flareGun.name: Flare gun
flareGun.desc: Fire it at Base Camp to call the helicopter. Everyone sees where you stand.

torch.name: Torch
torch.desc: Lights your way. Enemies can see it too.

snare.name: Snare
snare.desc: Place it on the ground. It cripples whoever steps in it.

splint.name: Splint
splint.desc: Sets a broken leg so you can run again.
